name: acceleratore
description: Acceleratore: idle game di fisica con minigioco La forma nascosta

scripts.check: node check.js && node check-game.js && node check-model.js && node check-budget.js && node check-i18n.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js
scripts.e2e:long: npm run build && E2E_LONG=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js --grep @long
scripts.e2e:perf: npm run build && E2E_ALL=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js --grep @perf
scripts.e2e:visual: npm run build && E2E_ALL=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.js --grep @visual
